info.title: LMS Support Service
info.description: Support tickets for students: routed by category to the batch staff, platform support or the exam team, with SLA timers, canned replies, internal notes, CSAT ratings and reports. Receives hand-offs from ai-tutor-service.

post.description: Routed by category: learning doubts to your institution's staff, technical/billing/access to platform support, integrity to the exam team. An `Idempotency-Key` makes a retried request return the same ticket.
